authFailed: Acorny: export token rejected — update it in Settings.
indexError: Acorny: sync stopped — the synced-document index looks incomplete, so syncing was aborted to avoid creating duplicate documents. ${reason}
setTokenFirst: Acorny: set your export token in Settings first.
selectNotebookFirst: Acorny: choose a target notebook in Settings first.
settingFolder: Document folder (path within notebook) — existing documents are moved here when you save
movedDocs: Acorny: moved ${count} document(s) into the new folder.
unexpectedError: Acorny: sync failed unexpectedly — see the developer console for details.
confirmDestinationFirst: Acorny: settings saved. Initial setup is not complete, so nothing syncs automatically yet — press “Save and sync now” in Settings, or the refresh icon in the top-right toolbar.
settingServerUrlDesc: Acorny API endpoint. Leave as is unless you self-host.
settingExportTokenDesc: Generate one in Acorny. Stored in this plugin’s data.json on this device and only ever sent to the server URL above.
settingNotebookDesc: Highlights are written into this notebook. Nothing syncs until you pick one.
settingFolderDesc: Path inside the notebook. Existing Acorny documents are moved here when you save.
settingSyncOnStartupDesc: Only takes effect after initial setup is complete — see “First sync” below.
settingPollIntervalDesc: 0 disables background syncing. Also only takes effect after initial setup.
settingSyncNowDescUnconfirmed: Initial setup is not complete, so nothing syncs automatically yet. Check the destination below, then press the button — it saves your settings, runs the first sync, and completes setup.
settingSyncNowDescConfirmed: Initial setup is complete — automatic syncing is active. You can still sync on demand here or from the refresh icon in the top-right toolbar.
destinationUnset: No notebook selected yet — nothing will be written.
resetInitedDone: Acorny: setup reset. Automatic syncing is off until you press “Save and sync now” again.
